text.content:
Carrying what nobody puts on the wire.

Turf: Everywhere a bike can go
Known for: Couriering chips, contracts, cash and the occasional organ
Allies & rivals: Nobody's. Neutral, and the Afterlife's favorite

An anarchist bicycle collective. In the Time of the Red, before the Linkup, half the city's messages moved on their bikes. In 2070 they carry what nobody wants on the CitiNet. They are still neutral, and still paid best by the Afterlife.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04, 06
